evidence: Cic. Amic. 71: odiōsum sānē genus hominum

terms.gloss: what kind of? what sort of?; of the kind that
evidence: Mart. 12.92.4: sī fīās tū leō, quālis eris?
Traupman 406: what kind of, what sort of, quālis

terms.gloss: of that (this) kind, that sort of
terms.grammar: genitive of quality, after its noun
evidence: Cic. Fin. 5.48: pompā, lūdīs atque ejus modī spectāculīs
terms.comment: Also written as one word, ejusmodī, hujusmodī.

phrases.english: What kind of ice cream do you want?

phrases.latin: dīc mihi, sī fīās tū leō, quālis eris?
phrases.english: tell me, if you turned into a lion, what kind of lion would you be?

phrases.english: a tiresome sort indeed, people who throw their favours in your face
